# Vendored HEIC converter

`heic-to.js` is the Content Security Policy-compatible browser build from `heic-to` version 1.5.2. It is loaded only when a visitor selects a HEIC or HEIF photo.

- Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic-to>
- Source: <https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to>
- License: LGPL-3.0; see `heic-to.LICENSE.txt`

The exact package version is pinned in `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. To refresh the browser bundle after an intentional dependency upgrade, copy `node_modules/heic-to/dist/csp/heic-to.js` into this directory and update the license file if it changed.
